title: Florence Pugh's parents put £1.65 million Oxfordshire barn where the Oppenheimer star grew up on sale
summary_full: Florence Pugh's parents, Clinton Pugh and Deborah Mackin, have listed their Grade II-listed Oxfordshire barn for £1.65 million. The Oppenheimer actress grew up in the 17th-century property, which her parents purchased for £950,000 in 2011. The couple are reportedly considering downsizing as their children have gradually moved out of the family home.
